preconditions.description: The number of vertices in the graph is between 2 and 500, inclusive.
The number of edges in the graph is between 1 and the maximum possible number of edges, which is either n * (n - 1) or 100000, whichever is smaller.
Each vertex in the graph is numbered between 1 and n, inclusive.
No edge starts and ends at the same vertex.

preconditions.expression: Each ordered pair (u, v) is listed at most once
preconditions.description: There is at most one directed edge from u to v.

postconditions.description: The output is either 'YES' or 'NO', indicating whether it is possible to make the graph acyclic by removing at most one edge.
